svg.title: Ravi Gohel — operator profile
svg.desc: B.Tech CSE (AI & ML) student. Student by chapter, builder by instinct. Open to work: AI/ML, Python and GenAI internships and jobs, remote or in India; also hackathons and collaboration. Interests mapped as a neural network: practical AI, machine learning, computer vision, GenAI, RAG, automation and full-stack development, feeding into intelligent systems.
